listing.tagline: Browse the session's folder and open files, beside its terminal
listing.description: A Kanban dock add-on. It lists the session's folder as a tree that loads one folder at a time. A click on a file previews it, and Ctrl+click opens it as a pane of the session. Ctrl+click on a folder makes it the root, Up goes to the parent with that folder still open, and Back, Forward and Home move through the folders you showed. With the add-on on the dock, a folder path in the terminal opens in it: a click offers it, and Ctrl+click opens it at once.
